propositions: Construct a legacy-default selector for exact summary-only mutations that bypasses generic retry without advancing baseline or provenance until S3 cutover.
Route exact {"summary"} mutations through the selector when tests explicitly enable it; all mixed-field mutations remain on a single unsplit legacy call path.

Map success dispositions (applied, recovered, and defensively already_satisfied) to the legacy result surface (result={"key": jira_key}) and advance the ADR-0026 baseline with the summary string from the routed mutation's fields["summary"].

Map all terminal non-success dispositions (commit_unknown, retryable_deferred, permanent_failure, exhausted_transient, and any further non-success) identically: emit a redacted per-mutation error message capped at 512 code points, persist no baseline/provenance advance, and continue the batch.
Preserve existing telemetry shapes, carry retry_not_before onto the manifest for observability only, and test exact-versus-mixed routing, retry poisoning, and the 512-code-point redaction boundary.
Name S3 as the sole production cutover, fuse/deferral consumer, and compatibility-bridge retirement owner in ADR 0103 and contract.
